episodes.title: The Moment He Realised the NXIVM Cult Leader Was Lying with Mark Vicente
episodes.description:
What happens when you realise the person you've trusted for over a decade has been lying to you?

In this gripping clip from A Life of Greatness, Sarah Grynberg speaks with filmmaker and former NXIVM member Mark Vicente about the moment he began uncovering the disturbing truth behind one of the world's most notorious cults.

After hearing multiple women describe a secret society involving controlled diets, intimate photographs and coercion, Mark confronted NXIVM leader Keith Raniere directly.

His response changed everything.

For the first time, Mark realised the man he had considered a mentor might have been deceiving him all along.

He also reveals how years of filming Keith Raniere, initially to promote his teachings, would later become crucial in exposing the organisation.

The conversation explores spiritual narcissism, manipulation and why powerful leaders sometimes document the very behaviour that contributes to their downfall.

Watch the full conversation with Mark Vicente on A Life of Greatness with Sarah Grynberg.

episodes.title: Mark Vicente: Inside the NXIVM Cult, How He Escaped & The Dark Truth About Spiritual Gurus
episodes.description:
How does someone searching for personal growth and enlightenment end up inside one of the world's most notorious cults? And how can you recognise manipulation when it's disguised as self-improvement?

In this extraordinary episode of A Life of Greatness, Sarah Grynberg sits down with Mark Vicente, filmmaker, author and former senior member of NXIVM, the controversial organisation led by convicted cult leader Keith Raniere.

Mark shares the remarkable story of how his search for meaning, spirituality and personal transformation led him into NXIVM, where he spent more than a decade believing he was part of a movement dedicated to changing the world.

From being flown across America on a private jet and introduced to powerful personal development techniques, to discovering the disturbing reality behind the organisation, Mark reveals how intelligent, well-intentioned people can become trapped in systems of psychological manipulation and control.

He opens up about the shocking discovery of NXIVM's secret society, the coercion and abuse of women, and the pivotal role his wife played in helping him recognise what was happening. He also recounts the extraordinary journey of exposing the organisation, speaking with journalists and law enforcement, and helping bring its leader to justice.

Beyond NXIVM, Mark explores the darker side of the personal development and spiritual wellness industries, including the dangers of narcissistic leaders, spiritual manipulation and the red flags people often overlook when searching for answers.

Drawing on his experiences and his work investigating destructive personalities, Mark explains why even the most inspiring teachers can become dangerous when power goes unchecked, and why learning to trust yourself may be the greatest lesson of all.
